tools.name: publish_app
tools.description: Packs a local folder and publishes it as a NEW app on Apprua, the user's own app server ("publish on Apprua" / "pubblica su Apprua" means this tool; the app gets its own address, https://<name>.<domain> or http://<name>.localhost). BEFORE calling: confirm with the user the app name, a one-line description, and whether the app saves data (persistent=true keeps /data across deploys). Never put secrets (API keys, passwords) in the files: use set_env after publishing. Supported: a Dockerfile, a Node/Python/... project, or a static folder with index.html. If the app needs to know who is using it (several people changing shared data, "changed by", conflicts), do not build a login: Apprua signs people in and its server side gets the headers X-Apprua-User (email), X-Apprua-User-Name (URL-encoded) and X-Apprua-Role, trusted only when the header X-Apprua-Key equals the variable APPRUA_APP_KEY; no X-Apprua-User means nobody signed in. After success, give the user the URL. On failure read the log, propose a fix, and use update_app.

path.description: Absolute path of the local folder to publish (on this PC). If the user says "this project", use the root folder of the project you are working on

name.description: App name = sub-domain, e.g. "my-notes" (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)

description.description: What the app does, one sentence

persistent.description: true if the app stores data (files/SQLite) in /data that must survive restarts and new versions

port.description: Port the app listens on, if not obvious (static sites: omit)

tools.name: update_app
tools.description: Publishes a new version of an EXISTING app of the user from a local folder. If the app was changed in the meantime from another copy, it refuses instead of overwriting: then use clone_app to get the latest version, apply the changes there and retry.

path.description: Absolute path of the local folder (on this PC); for "this project" use the root of the current project

name.description: App name (optional if the folder was published or cloned before)

tools.name: list_my_apps
tools.description: Lists the user's apps on Apprua with status and URL.

tools.name: app_status
tools.description: Status, URL, limits, last deploy and recent versions of one of the user's apps.

name.description: App name = sub-domain, e.g. "my-notes" (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)

tools.name: app_logs
tools.description: Last log lines of an app: type "runtime" (the running app) or "build" (last deploy). Use it to diagnose errors and propose fixes.

name.description: App name = sub-domain, e.g. "my-notes" (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)

tools.name: restart_app
tools.description: Restart app (only apps owned by the user).

name.description: App name = sub-domain, e.g. "my-notes" (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)

tools.name: start_app
tools.description: Start app (only apps owned by the user).

name.description: App name = sub-domain, e.g. "my-notes" (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)

tools.name: stop_app
tools.description: Stop app (only apps owned by the user). The app stays offline until start_app. Confirm with the user first.

name.description: App name = sub-domain, e.g. "my-notes" (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)

tools.name: set_env
tools.description: Sets an environment variable / secret of the app (e.g. an API key or a database password) and restarts it. The value is stored on the server, never in the code, and is never shown back. Ask the user for the value; do not write it in any file.

name.description: App name = sub-domain, e.g. "my-notes" (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)

tools.name: unset_env
tools.description: Removes an environment variable / secret from the app and restarts it. app_status lists the names that are set (never the values).

name.description: App name = sub-domain, e.g. "my-notes" (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)

tools.name: restore_version
tools.description: Puts an earlier version of the app online again: it becomes the newest version (nothing is lost, the history is kept) and is published. app_status lists the versions (commit, date, message). Use it when the latest version broke something. Confirm with the user first.

name.description: App name = sub-domain, e.g. "my-notes" (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)

commit.description: commit of the version, from app_status

tools.name: set_visibility
tools.description: Who can open the app when Apprua is on the local network or the internet: "private" (only the owner and the administrators), "team" (anyone with an Apprua account, the default) or "public" (anyone, no sign-in: only for apps meant for everybody). Applies at once. Ask the user before making an app public.

name.description: App name = sub-domain, e.g. "my-notes" (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)

tools.name: archive_app
tools.description: Stops and archives an app of the user: code and data are kept and an administrator can restore it. Confirm with the user first.

name.description: App name = sub-domain, e.g. "my-notes" (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)

tools.name: clone_app
tools.description: Downloads the latest code of one of the user's apps into a new local folder, to change it and publish it again with update_app.

name.description: App name = sub-domain, e.g. "my-notes" (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)

path.description: Absolute path of the destination folder (must not exist)
